scene.ofreeRecent: a hangar maintenance bay — holds her keepsake up beside her face; a rooftop open-air listening lounge at dusk with a low sofa and an urban skyline — leaning forward to listen closely to a vinyl record while holding its plain inner sleeve on her knees; a small mountain-path shrine at the Slope of the Fallen Phoenix — dries her hair with a towel; a quiet sleeper-train compartment at sunrise — waking slowly and stretching a soft slipper toward the floor while listening to music from a small speaker; a night river covered with floating paper lanterns — standing; an open-air hot spring among steaming rocks — holds her keepsake in both hands in front of her; a starship observation deck with a vast curved window onto a nebula — folds a freshly washed sheet against her chest; an outdoor pool with lounge chairs and clear blue water — chest-deep in the water; a riverside pavilion tower over the Yangtze — perched on a ledge or edge; a walkway through a forest dome inside a colony ship — standing; a misty enchanted garden of moss — holds her keepsake at chest height; a glass greenhouse full of plants with a wooden potting bench — standing close to a high shelf or line; a rocky coast path with tide pools — sips a tall iced coffee in a clear cup with a straw through the straw
